name: The Brazier (station 2, Oasis 3 of Route B; PLAN.md section 6): Al-Mijmarah on the inter-Twin col at 4,680 m (0.89 atm), a geothermal oasis 800 x 500 m along a fault-fissure in the frozen col: sinter-lipped hot pools, low geyser cones, mud pots, orange and black thermophile mats down the runoff, bobby-sock sedge flats, the Hearths' dwarf pocket-hearths, the Shrine of the Split Horn where the guide's second coin falls due, Route B's cairns on toward the Brimstone-Tarn; the two fissure vents steaming 20 km off either side
